name: galaxyquest-tests
description: Test tooling for GalaxyQuest frontend/unit tests

scripts.test:e2e:battle-video: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:GQ_RUN_BATTLE_E2E='1'; $env:GQ_WEBGPU_SHADER_CI='1'; $env:GQ_BASE_URL=($env:GQ_BASE_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'); if (-not $env:PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH) { $edge = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::ProgramFilesX86)) 'Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'; if (Test-Path $edge) { $env:PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH = $edge } }; playwright test tests/e2e/battle-engine-video.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=line"
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:renderer+viewflow: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:GQ_RUN_RENDERER_SMOKE='1'; playwright test tests/e2e/system-enter-renderer.spec.js tests/e2e/view-flow.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=line"
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:renderer+viewflow:gpu-bas: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:GQ_RUN_RENDERER_SMOKE='1'; $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE ?? '2'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_SYSTEM_ENTER=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_SYSTEM_ENTER ?? '4'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW ?? '1'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV ?? '1'); playwright test tests/e2e/system-enter-renderer.spec.js tests/e2e/view-flow.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=line"
scripts.test:e2e:viewflow:seeded: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "docker compose exec -T web php scripts/ensure_default_e2e_user.php --username=default_user --password=User!23456 --email=default_user@local.test; playwright test tests/e2e/view-flow.spec.js --reporter=line"
scripts.test:e2e:viewflow:seeded:gpu-baseline: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE ?? '2'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW ?? '1'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV ?? '1'); docker compose exec -T web php scripts/ensure_default_e2e_user.php --username=default_user --password=User!23456 --email=default_user@local.test; playwright test tests/e2e/view-flow.spec.js --reporter=line"

scripts.test:e2e:viewflow:seeded:native:gpu-base: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:GQ_VIEWFLOW_NATIVE_ONLY='1'; $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE ?? '2'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW ?? '1'); $env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV=($env:GQ_E2E_GPU_WARN_BASELINE_VIEWFLOW_NAV ??
